title: Present perfect continuous (I have been doing)

cards.text: Present perfect continuous: have/has been + -ing. Dipakai untuk kegiatan yang baru saja berhenti dan hasilnya masih terlihat.

examples.en: Why are you wet? Have you been swimming?
She's tired. She's been working all day.

cards.text: Juga untuk kegiatan yang dimulai di masa lalu dan masih berlangsung sampai sekarang, terutama dengan how long, for, since.

examples.en: It's been raining for two hours.
How long have you been learning English?
examples.id: Sudah berapa lama kamu belajar bahasa Inggris?

cards.text: Bandingkan present continuous (sedang terjadi sekarang) dengan present perfect continuous (sudah berapa lama berlangsung).

examples.en: I've been waiting for an hour.
examples.id: Saya sudah menunggu selama satu jam.

cards.trap: Bahasa Indonesia cukup memakai "sudah ... selama". Bahasa Inggris tidak memakai present continuous untuk lama waktu: bukan I am waiting for an hour.

questions.why: Hujan baru saja berhenti dan hasilnya terlihat (tanah basah), jadi has been raining.

questions.prompt: We ___ (wait) for the bus for 30 minutes.
questions.why: Lama kegiatan yang masih berlangsung (for 30 minutes) memakai have been + -ing.

questions.prompt: Susun pertanyaan: "Sudah berapa lama kamu bekerja di sini?"
questions.answer: How long have you been working here?
questions.why: Pertanyaan lama waktu: How long + have + you + been + -ing.

questions.prompt: Rini has ___ teaching for ten years.

questions.answer: I have been learning English since 2020.
questions.why: Untuk kegiatan yang dimulai di masa lalu dan masih berlangsung (since 2020), pakai present perfect continuous.
Menanyakan lamanya kegiatan yang masih berlangsung sampai sekarang: Have you been + -ing.

questions.source: Dia sudah menonton TV sepanjang hari.
questions.answer: He has been watching TV all day
accept: She has been watching TV all day
questions.why: Kegiatan yang berlangsung sepanjang hari sampai sekarang memakai has been + -ing.

pairs: Why are your hands so dirty?
Why are you out of breath?
Why is the kitchen so messy?
questions.why: Setiap jawaban menjelaskan kegiatan yang baru saja berhenti dan hasilnya masih terlihat.

questions.prompt: Look! Those children ___ in the river right now.
questions.why: right now = sedang terjadi saat ini, jadi present continuous.

questions.prompt: Andi has been playing the guitar since he was ten.
questions.answer: Andi has been playing the guitar since he was ten.
questions.why: Kalimat ini sudah benar: kegiatan berulang yang dimulai di masa lalu dan masih berlanjut sampai sekarang.
